## Summary

Converges Aftergraph Studio onto one canonical `/studio/*` application shell while preserving governed OpenUI as the dynamic content layer.

### Included
- `/studio/chat`, `/studio/work`, `/studio/space` base-aware routing with typed deep-link preservation

- desktop Chat / Work / Space navigation; mobile permanent primary modes are exactly Chat + Work, with Space and contextual products in the canonical drawer
- mobile safe-area drawer and >=44px interaction targets
- fail-safe cold-start rendering before backend hydration
- lazy optional Federation refresh to avoid cold-start 404 probes
- Billing launcher stays inside Studio instead of escaping to a parallel interface
- canonical final style layer and service-worker coverage
- migrated V4/V5/V6/fullstack/viewport QA contracts to the canonical shell
- DOM optimization that keeps Work at the existing performance budget rather than widening the budget

## Governance / OpenUI invariant

The shell remains deterministic and first-party. OpenUI may generate governed content inside the workspace; it does not own routing, authority, endpoints or arbitrary HTML.

## Exact-head verification

issue.title: feat(characters): add actor presence asset system
issue.body:
## Summary

Builds the canonical editable Aftergraph Character System as a production asset pipeline:

`layered SVG anatomy → locked anchors/rig → role/state/expression composition → governed attachment slots → dark/light derived vectors → runtime sprites → review/evidence surfaces → SVG/PNG/WebP/AVIF exports → deterministic Rive runtime projection → exact-candidate production promotion`

The legacy 23-symbol `character-sprite.svg` remains only as a deprecated compatibility output. Canonical authoring stays under `characters/source/`.

## Canonical source

- editable 512×512 base anatomy with named groups/gradients
- locked anchors, pivots, gaze/halo/prop attachment points
- 6 governed roles
- 11 governed runtime states
- reusable expressions
- rig hierarchy + transform limits
- governed role/state attachment-slot collision policy
- Supporting Icons v1 diff + only-new artwork source

## Derived asset system

`npm run generate` deterministically produces:

- 6 standalone role SVGs
- 11 standalone state SVGs
- 6 avatars
- 66 role×state compositions
- 11 new supporting icons
- 89-symbol dark character sprite
- 89-symbol light character sprite
- 11-symbol icon sprite
- deterministic human-review surface
- Rive RML/Luau source projection from the same governed compositions

Light variants are derived from Brand OS tokens; there is no separate hand-authored light family.

## Rive runtime

- official CLI: `rive 1.0.3`
- source project: `characters/motion/rive/`
- bound fields: `role`, `state`, `attention`, `reducedMotion`
- all 66 role×state combinations project to native Rive/Luau drawing; no raster embedding
- runtime artifact: `characters/motion/rive/build/aftergraph_actor_presence.riv`
- size: **1,559,875 bytes**
- SHA-256: `8847206f604b720f945908c27b4ceca73a817536f493dca4dab40e33507fb8f3`
- build: **0 errors / 0 warnings**
- runtime QA covers all **11 states**, all **6 roles**, ViewModel roundtrip, measurable active motion, and **0 reduced-motion pixel drift**

SVG remains source-of-truth. `.riv` is a governed derived runtime artifact.

## Release surface

`characters/release.json` governs dark + light themes, SVG/PNG/WebP/AVIF, 89 theme-specific assets per theme, 11 theme-neutral supporting icons, **189 governed logical assets**, **756 export files**, and SHA-256 release manifests. Raster files are delivery artifacts only.

## Exact-candidate production promotion

Production now preserves the reviewed candidate as immutable evidence instead of rewriting a candidate commit to fit later evidence.

1. Manual workflow receives an exact `candidate_sha` plus completed Illustrator and human brand-review evidence.
2. It checks out that exact candidate and runs candidate/core/Rive verification first.
3. External evidence is materialized only in the packaging job and validated against the exact candidate.
4. `npm run character:release:promote -- --candidate <sha>` derives release metadata only after both external gates validate.
5. Promotion writes `characters/production-attestation.json` binding candidate SHA, pre/post-promotion release hashes, both evidence file hashes, truth boundary, and Rive runtime hash.
6. `npm run character:production:verify` fails closed on missing, stale, tampered, or candidate-mismatched evidence/attestation.
7. Only then are the 756 governed delivery assets and npm candidate packed with SHA-256 manifests.

The production workflow does **not** merge or publish automatically.

## Automated QA — exact HEAD `9d12b2d98e3e1d1dc39f10089191f462c8b88774`

Local verification on the committed implementation:

- full suite: **116/116 tests PASS**
- Brand OS + character validators PASS
- composition bounds: **66/66 PASS**
- small-size QA: **96/96 PASS**
- context QA: **24/24 PASS**
- visual regression: **23/23 PASS**
- Rive source/build/runtime QA PASS
- dependency audit: **0 high-severity vulnerabilities**
- full character export: **189 logical assets / 756 files**
- npm package generated successfully
- workflow YAML parsing PASS
- `git diff --check` PASS

Remote exact-HEAD verification:

- **CI & Brand Token Verification #93 — SUCCESS** ✅
- **CodeQL #90 — SUCCESS** ✅
- **Character External Review Bundle #4 — SUCCESS** ✅
- review artifact: `aftergraph-character-review-9d12b2d98e3e1d1dc39f10089191f462c8b88774`
- artifact digest: `sha256:9b9f49beae4748db1938701e56db71e83b24dec68a95865545e567231d1aa3f2`

## Remaining external gates

- Adobe Illustrator roundtrip: **pending external** — open/edit/save/reopen canonical SVG and record exact-candidate evidence
- human brand review: **pending external** — explicit reviewer assessment against the exact-candidate review bundle

Production verification intentionally reports `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_GATES` until both external gates are real. Once they are supplied, the manual production workflow performs promotion, attestation, production verification, export, and packaging without mutating the reviewed candidate.

**Characters are a view. Evidence is the truth.**

No merge requested. Keep this PR draft until the remaining external gates are complete.

Current verified state:
- production deploy job is exact-main-only and runs on repository-scoped self-hosted runner `lenovo-aftergraph-site-deploy`

- `ENABLE_DEPLOY=true`
- merged main `9d642cacf4016ffd2a673e44f73e73d6220c5a83` deployed automatically in Actions run `34957198860`
- hosted gates passed, deploy passed, exact-HEAD production verification passed
- independent VDS smoke also passed for `/`, `/launch`, launcher assets/registry, `/status`, `/sentinel`, `/community`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/llms.txt`, telemetry GET=405, and `/healthz` exact SHA
